post-autoload-dump: @php -r "if (is_dir('.git') && is_dir('.githooks')) { @mkdir('.git/hooks', 0755, true); foreach (glob('.githooks/*') ?: [] as \$hook) { if (!is_file(\$hook)) continue; \$name = basename(\$hook); copy(\$hook, '.git/hooks/' . \$name); chmod('.git/hooks/' . \$name, 0755); } }"
dev: npx concurrently -c "#93c5fd,#c4b5fd,#fb7185,#fdba74,#86efac" "php artisan serve" "php artisan queue:listen --tries=1" "php artisan pail --timeout=0" "npm run dev" "composer run mailpit:follow" --names=server,queue,logs,vite,mailpit --kill-others
dev:lan: npx concurrently -c "#93c5fd,#c4b5fd,#fb7185,#fdba74,#86efac" "php artisan serve --host=0.0.0.0 --port=8000" "php artisan queue:listen --tries=1" "php artisan pail --timeout=0" "npm run dev:lan" "composer run mailpit:follow" --names=server,queue,logs,vite,mailpit --kill-others
dev:ssr: npx concurrently -c "#93c5fd,#c4b5fd,#fb7185,#fdba74" "php artisan serve" "php artisan queue:listen --tries=1" "php artisan pail --timeout=0" "php artisan inertia:start-ssr" --names=server,queue,logs,ssr --kill-others
mailpit:start: docker start ovrload-mailpit 2>/dev/null || docker run -d --name ovrload-mailpit -p 2525:1025 -p 8026:8025 axllent/mailpit
mailpit:follow: bash -c 'if ! docker start ovrload-mailpit >/dev/null 2>&1 && ! docker run -d --name ovrload-mailpit -p 2525:1025 -p 8026:8025 axllent/mailpit >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "[mailpit] Docker unavailable — skipping catcher"; exec sleep infinity; fi; echo "[mailpit] UI → http://127.0.0.1:8026 (SMTP :2525)"; exec docker logs -f --tail=0 ovrload-mailpit'
